blurb: A trading republic built on wooden piles in a lagoon, independent for over a thousand years.

facts.t: Marco Polo left Venice in 1271 and came home in 1295. Captured in a war with Genoa, he told his story to a fellow prisoner, Rustichello, who wrote it down.

src.n: Wikipedia: The Travels of Marco Polo

facts.t: Vivaldi taught music for decades at the Ospedale della Pietà, a home for abandoned girls whose orchestra was famous across Europe. Much of The Four Seasons' world was first played by them.
In 1797 Napoleon's army ended the Republic of Venice after 1,100 years. His soldiers took the four bronze horses of St Mark's to Paris; they came back in 1815.

src.n: Wikipedia: Fall of the Republic of Venice
